name: Armored Siege Royal
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: native transparent static 2D side-view character sprite.
Primary request: ONE original Armored Siege Royal.
Input image 1 is the base identity/anatomy and shaded sprite-style reference only. Select the intact upright top-row posture; never reproduce the sheet.
Preserve its heavy charcoal-gray bipedal Siege Royal anatomy: large broad ridged cranial crest with stacked curved shell bands, rounded shoulder guards, exposed ribbed organic torso, exactly TWO clawed arms and TWO digitigrade legs, small dorsal tubes, ONE long segmented tapered tail. No four-armed queen conversion.
Variant lock: Original systemic armored variant: preserve the exact base anatomy, equipment and silhouette family, with practical layered protection. Organic creatures have natural carapace plates, not mechanical suits. People retain recognizable uniforms and equipment with additional guards. Preserve base identity colors and surface relief. No extra appendages or new weapons.
Make the existing organic carapace plates thicker and overlapping across crest, shoulders, torso and limbs. Preserve dark gray/black identity and sculpted relief, with subtle neutral highlights rather than metal machinery.
Composition: one whole static ready stance facing RIGHT, slight side-three-quarter angle, both arms and legs clearly separated. Entire cranial crest, fingertips, toes, dorsal tubes, tail and its tip visible. Fit the whole silhouette inside central 80% with at least 10% empty padding on every side.
Background: real transparent alpha only, no ground, shadow, scenery, aura.
No grid, multiple poses, sheet, labels, text, logo, crop, extra appendages, mechanical equipment, weapons, wounds or gore. Original systemic adaptation, not canon certification or animation.
